facts.fact: Sandy 认出这座石阵正是梦里见过的那一处，低声念完护身咒语后爬上泥炭丘、进入石圈。
facts.anchor: They recognized this particular configuration of stones, for it was the same one that they had seen in their dream.

facts.fact: 石圈由十二块不规则石灰岩石柱环绕中央第十三块石组成，浓雾像灰幕一样遮住石圈外的世界。
facts.anchor: There were twelve obelisks of irregular limestone, blooming with gray-green lichen, all arranged in a ring around a thirteenth stone at the circle’s epicenter.

facts.fact: George 把石圈里的帆布帐篷用捡来的垃圾布置成小窝，招呼 Sandy 进去坐。
facts.anchor: Oi, welcome to the den o’ sin. Make yourself at home!

facts.fact: George 介绍帐篷里的剥制标本 Jocko：它活着时替父亲下洞抓猎物，农场从没闹过兔子。
facts.anchor: Back when he was alive, we didn’t have no trouble with rabbits on the farm. My da sent him down a hole and he’d always come back with a catch.

facts.fact: George 开讲修女故事的教会版本：修女在此被魔鬼引诱，各地女巫乘扫帚夜飞到石圈行安息日。
facts.anchor: The church said that this is where those nuns were seduced by the devil.

facts.fact: George 修正教会说法：修女们遇到的是岛上早于基督徒与罗马人的古老存在，并说 Helena Hollyoak 也是在这里遇到它。
facts.anchor: They met something much older, something that’s been on this island for a long, long time, back to before the Christians, back to before the Romans.

facts.fact: George 笑着承认那份 elk’s blood 被特别祝圣献给 Round Robin；Sandy 随即怒斥对方下药、质问 consent。
facts.anchor: It’s specially consecrated to Round Robin.

facts.fact: 结尾帐篷门帘被扯开，一只多毛的手抓住 Sandy 的背心把他们拽出帐篷；Sandy 心想 Round Robin has got me。
facts.anchor: the tent flap burst open and a hairy hand reached in and grabbed Sandy by the front of their tank top, claws snagging the thin fabric.
